title_zh: 修正虚构参议院提案的表决状态

scenario.label_zh: 虚构参议院提案与通过状态
scenario.goal_zh: 区分议员提交提案和参议院通过决议，将课堂图表状态改为等待表决

context_zh: 公民教育课堂使用完全虚构的参议院卡片练习机构与程序用语，不涉及现实政治新闻。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Dara
sentences.text: This card says the senator has submitted a resolution asking for longer library hours.

sentences.speaker: Colin
sentences.text: So can I write that the senate has approved the change?

sentences.speaker: Dara
sentences.text: No. The next card says the vote is scheduled for Thursday. One member has proposed it, but the chamber has not decided.

sentences.speaker: Colin
sentences.text: Then the status should be "awaiting a vote," not "approved."

sentences.speaker: Dara
sentences.text: Exactly. We can show the proposal reaching the chamber without drawing an arrow to implementation.

sentences.speaker: Colin
sentences.text: I have changed the status box to "awaiting a vote" and removed that final arrow.

sentences.speaker: Dara
sentences.text: That now matches the cards. Leave the result open until the exercise gives us the vote.

targets.sense_zh: 提交审议的正式决议案
